lines: What if truth is not invented, but discovered?
如果真理不是被发明的，而是被发现的呢？
What if every proof a machine checks becomes a coordinate: a fixed point, in a space that no one can see all at once?
如果机器核验的每一个证明，都成为一个坐标——一个不动点，处在一个没有人能一眼看全的空间里？
This is trureturing. True. Return. Turing.
这就是 trureturing。真理 · 回返 · 图灵。
An open experiment in giving machines a scientific method: to ask questions, test their own conjectures, and return what they verify to a library that only grows.
一个开放的实验：给机器一套科学方法——提出问题，检验自己的猜想，再把验证过的东西交还给一座只增不减的图书馆。
It begins with a philosophical bet. Truth is not created by the act of computing it.
它始于一个哲学赌注：真理，不是被计算这一行为创造出来的。
Call the whole network of truths, and all their logical relations, the Dao. Or God.
把全部真理及其逻辑关系构成的那张网，称为“道”，或者“神”。
A finite observer never sees that network whole. It discovers the connections, one at a time.
有限的观察者永远看不到这张网的全貌，只能一条一条地发现其中的连接。
And the project is careful to say: this is an orientation, not a theorem. It proves nothing about God, or the universe.
项目也说得很清楚：这是一种方向，不是定理。它没有证明任何关于神或宇宙的事。
So who is allowed to say what is true? Here, exactly one thing: code that passes the Lean four kernel.
那么，谁有资格说什么是真的？在这里只有一样东西：通过 Lean 4 内核检验的代码。
Not prose. Not intuition. Not a confident model. Declarations, proof terms, and their axiom closure. Nothing else carries truth.
不是散文，不是直觉，也不是一个自信的模型。只有声明、证明项和它们的公理闭包承载真值。
Today that is more than five thousand Lean files. Nearly a million lines. Almost thirty thousand theorems and lemmas.
今天，这里有五千多个 Lean 文件，将近一百万行，接近三万条定理与引理。
Any extra axiom must be declared in the open, or it is rejected.
任何额外的公理都必须公开登记，否则一律拒收。
Every verified result becomes a node in a directed acyclic graph of truth.
每一个被验证的结果，都成为“真理有向无环图”上的一个节点。
Once the kernel accepts it, the node is frozen. Permanently. It is never unfrozen. The graph can only grow.
一旦内核接受，这个节点就被冻结。永久冻结，永不解冻。这张图只能生长。
Each node is addressed by the hashes of everything beneath it. Change one pearl, and every reflection above it changes. Indra's net, rebuilt out of cryptography.
每个节点都由它下方一切内容的哈希来寻址。动一颗珍珠，它之上所有的映像都随之改变——用密码学重建的因陀罗网。
Nearly five thousand modules are already frozen. The only place where work happens is the frontier: the open edge, where no proof exists yet.
已有近五千个模块被冻结。唯一有工作可做的地方是前沿：那条还没有证明存在的开放边界。
One thread runs through the golden ratio.
其中一条线索，贯穿黄金比例。
Every natural number has exactly one way to be written as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Forty-two is thirty-four, plus eight.
每个自然数都恰好有一种方式，写成互不相邻的斐波那契数之和。42 = 34 + 8。
Now replace each Fibonacci weight with a power of phi. Call the result beta of n. Does this new coordinate preserve addition?
把每个斐波那契权重换成 φ 的幂，得到 β(n)。这个新坐标保持加法吗？
Not quite. But the error is trapped. For every pair of natural numbers, forever, the deficit is minus one, zero, or one.
并不完全。但误差被困住了：对任意一对自然数，永远，亏量只能是 −1、0 或 1。
Three values. Proved for all inputs, not just the ones anyone happened to test.
三个值。对所有输入成立，而不只是碰巧被测试过的那些。
Machines can also kill conjectures.
机器也能终结猜想。
In twenty twelve, a closed formula was conjectured for the OEIS sequence A, one seven five, four oh six.
2012 年，有人为 OEIS 数列 A175406 猜想了一个闭式公式。
Then, at one particular sixteen-digit number, it is off by exactly one.
然而在一个特定的十六位数上，它恰好差了 1。
The refutation is not a numerical hunch. It is a Lean theorem, named result, whose type is: not claim. It rests on certified bounds for the logarithm of two.
这个反驳不是数值直觉，而是一条 Lean 定理：名为 result，类型是“¬ claim”，建立在 log 2 的认证界之上。
More than four hundred dossiers of published conjectures and questions are tracked this way, each with its sources and a literature check.
四百多份已发表猜想与问题的卷宗按这种方式追踪，每一份都附有出处和文献核查。
The deepest thread is about blindness: what observations cannot tell you.
最深的一条线索关于“盲区”：观察告诉不了你的东西。
Take two qubits. One pair is an entangled Bell state. The other is a plain classical coin flip, between zero zero and one one.
取两个量子比特：一对处于纠缠的贝尔态；另一对只是经典地掷硬币，在 00 与 11 之间随机。
Look at each qubit alone, and they are identical. Exactly the same local description. Yet the wholes are different.
单独看每个量子比特，两者完全相同，局部描述一模一样。但整体不同。
For finite systems, the theorem measures precisely what the local views omit: a hidden correlation sector, of dimension m squared minus one, times n squared minus one.
对有限维系统，定理精确量出局部视角遗漏的部分：一个维数为 (m²−1)(n²−1) 的隐藏关联扇区。
And one criterion ties it together: a target can be recovered from an observation exactly when the target is constant on every fiber, every set of states that look the same.
一个判据把这一切串起来：目标能从观察中恢复，当且仅当它在每一条“纤维”——每一组看起来相同的状态——上都是常数。
This is where the holography begins.
全息，从这里开始。
Imagine one history, seen through many windows. Each window shows only a part. Some of them overlap.
想象同一段历史，透过许多扇窗去看。每扇窗只露出一部分，有些窗彼此重叠。
Which windows, and which relations, are enough to reconstruct the whole? At what resolution? At what cost?
哪些窗、哪些关系，足以重建整体？在什么分辨率下？代价是多少？
In one finite model, adding a single inactive event leaves the present spatial snapshot untouched, yet makes a temporal composition illegal. A snapshot is not a history.
在一个有限模型里，加入一个不活跃的事件，当前的空间快照纹丝不动，却让一次时间上的组合变得不合法。快照不等于历史。
And the boundary is stated honestly: these are models of observation. Not a derivation of physical spacetime.
边界也被诚实地写明：这些是观察的模型，不是对物理时空的推导。
Every new theorem is asked four questions.
每一条新定理，都要回答四个问题。
Where did information escape? How was that escape handled? What new information emerged? And where does it keep escaping?
信息从哪里逃逸？逃逸如何被处理？出现了什么新信息？它又在哪里继续逃逸？
The judge is still under construction. Its aim is not to reward sounding smart, but to show which distinctions became visible, and which remain in the dark.
这个判官仍在建设中。它不奖励“听起来聪明”，只标出哪些区分变得可见，哪些仍在黑暗里。
So who decides what is true? Not a human. Not a confident model.
那么，谁来决定什么是真的？不是人，也不是一个自信的模型。
Proofs go to the kernel. Arguments go to adversarial reviewers from different model families. Every merge passes the same machine checks, whether it comes from a maintainer, a stranger, or an AI.
证明交给内核；论证交给来自不同模型家族的对抗评审。每一次合并都要通过同样的机器检查——无论来自维护者、陌生人，还是 AI。
Any gate that ends in 'awaiting human review' is treated as a bug. Humans choose directions, and authorize the irreversible. Machines judge right and wrong.
任何以“等待人工审核”结束的门，都被视为 bug。人选择方向、授权不可逆的动作；对与错，由机器判定。
At the center sit two open hearts.
在中心，有两颗开放的心脏。
One, O six, states Weil's positivity criterion: a classical doorway to the Riemann hypothesis. The statement is written. Its proof is not.
一颗叫 O-6，写下了韦伊正性判据——通往黎曼猜想的一扇经典之门。陈述已经写好，证明还没有。
The other, O five, has a proof body of a single deliberate word: sorry.
另一颗叫 O-5，它的证明体只有一个刻意留下的词：sorry。
The project says it plainly: it has not solved the Riemann hypothesis. What is not proved is marked open. Not hidden. Not faked.
项目明白地说：它没有解决黎曼猜想。没有证明的，就标为 open。不隐藏，不伪造。
Gödel proved that every consistent formal system strong enough for arithmetic leaves some truths unprovable. The repository can run unattended. Honesty cannot.
哥德尔证明：任何足以表达算术的一致形式系统，都有无法证明的真命题。仓库可以无人值守，诚实不能。
Primes never run out. Neither does the frontier.
素数永远不会用尽，前沿也一样。
This is a search for the primes of truth: irreducible, verified, fixed in place, one node at a time.
这是一场对“真理素数”的搜寻：不可约，被验证，固定在原位，一次一个节点。
The last line of the ledger is always the first line of the next round.
账本的最后一行，永远是下一轮的第一行。
And if thou gaze long into an abyss, the abyss will also gaze into thee.
当你长久凝视深渊，深渊也在凝视你。
